legend: An atypical lymphocyte characteristic of Sézary syndrome (Giemsa) (<<30937>>). An electron micrograph of a Sézary cell showing a nucleus with invaginated nuclear membranes and deep nuclear clefting (<<30867>>).
Erythroderma in Sézary syndrome. A generalized erythrodermic rash with patchy reddening and scaling of skin.

An atypical lymphocyte characteristic of Sézary syndrome (Giemsa) (<<30937>>). An electron micrograph of a Sézary cell showing a nucleus with invaginated nuclear membranes and deep nuclear clefting (<<30867>>).

There is paracortical expansion by an atypical lymphoid population composed of medium-sized lymphocytes (<<30938>>). The atypical lymphocytes have abundant clear cytoplasm and irregular nuclear features (<<30939>>). Neoplastic cells of Sézary syndrome demonstrate highly irregular, convoluted nuclei with clefts (<<30941>>). CD3 immunohistochemistry highlights the neoplastic cells of Sézary syndrome within the paracortical regions of the lymph node (<<30940>>).
